extracted.name: Slow Cooker Overnight Oatmeal with Apples, Cranberries, and Walnuts
extracted.description: This slow cooker overnight oatmeal with apples, cranberries, and walnuts recipe is an easy way to enjoy steel-cut oats. Leftovers make a quick breakfast.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Line a 3 ½- or 4-quart slow cooker with a disposable slow cooker liner. Add apples, oats, cranberries, brown sugar, butter, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg; pour in milk and water. Stir to combine. Cover the slow cooker.
Cook on Low for 6 to 8 hours. Top servings with walnuts.
